:::{#exm-product-measure}
#### Product measures

- For the counting measure $\mu$ on the die rolls $D$,
  $(\mu \otimes \mu)(A \times B) = \abs{A} \abs{B}$,
  the number of pairs in $A \times B$.
  For example, the set of pairs in which both rolls are even is
  $\set{2, 4, 6} \times \set{2, 4, 6}$,
  with $(\mu \otimes \mu)(\set{2, 4, 6} \times \set{2, 4, 6}) = 3 \cdot 3 = 9$ pairs.
- For Lebesgue measure $\lambda$ on $\reals$,
  $(\lambda \otimes \lambda)([0, 2] \times [0, 3]) = 2 \cdot 3 = 6$,
  the area of the rectangle.

:::
